description: Angular component for configuring switch node scripts in Thingsboard, including form handling, script validation, and testing.

classes.name: SwitchConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent for switch node script configuration, including form setup, validation, and testing.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for switch configuration.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form control names that trigger validation.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates validators based on script language and enabled state.

methods.name: prepareInputConfig
methods.description: Prepares configuration object with default values if missing.

methods.name: testScript
methods.description: Tests the script via NodeScriptTestService and updates form with result.

methods.name: onValidate
methods.description: Performs validation, especially for JavaScript scripts.
